title: Obligation in Formal Language: köteles and kénytelen

sections.title: Formal Language of Rental Agreements
sections.content: You know *kell* and *muszáj* + infinitive from A1 Unit 24. Formal texts and contracts also use *köteles* (is obliged to: a rule or a contract requires it) and *kénytelen* (has no choice but to) + infinitive. Both are adjectives and agree with the person: *köteles vagyok*, *kötelesek vagyunk*; in the 3rd person there is no *van*: *a főbérlő köteles*.

items.spanish: Kötelesek vagyunk havonta fizetni a rezsit.
items.english: We are obliged to pay the utilities every month.

items.spanish: A főbérlő köteles aláírni a bérleti szerződést.
items.english: The landlord is obliged to sign the lease.

items.spanish: A lakás drága, ezért kénytelen vagyok másik lakást keresni.
items.english: The flat is expensive, so I have no choice but to look for another one.
